description: Source file implementing the 'Message' class for RPC communication in PyTorch's distributed module, including constructors, accessors, and utility functions.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents an RPC message with payload, tensors, type, and ID, supporting request/response identification and storage retrieval.

methods.name: movePayload
methods.description: Moves and returns the payload vector.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Returns a reference to the payload vector.

methods.name: payload (const)
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the payload vector.

methods.name: moveTensors
methods.description: Moves and returns the tensors vector.

methods.name: tensors
methods.description: Returns a reference to the tensors vector.

methods.name: tensors (const)
methods.description: Returns a const reference to the tensors vector.

methods.name: isRequest
methods.description: Checks if the message is a request.

methods.name: isResponse
methods.description: Checks if the message is a response.

methods.name: getStorages
methods.description: Retrieves storage pointers from tensors, handling sparse tensors.
